        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)

        self.Securities[self._spy].SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)

        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        option.SetFilter(-100, 100, timedelta(days=0), timedelta(days=365))
        self._option_symbol = option.Symbol

        self._fast = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self._slow = SimpleMovingAverage(20)
        self._previous_fast = None
        self._previous_slow = None
        self._entry_signal_time = None

        self._held_symbol = None
        self._entry_price = None
        self._entry_order_id = None
        self._exit_order_id = None
        self._no_entry_date = None

        consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        consolidator.DataConsolidated += self._on_five_minute_bar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self._spy, consolidator)

        self.Schedule.On(
            self.DateRules.EveryDay(self._spy),
            self.TimeRules.At(15, 45),
            self._time_stop
        )

    def OnData(self, slice):
        if self.Portfolio[self._spy].Quantity != 0:
            if not self.Transactions.GetOpenOrders(self._spy):
                self.Debug("Unexpected SPY exercise/assignment position detected; liquidating.")
                self.MarketOrder(self._spy, -self.Portfolio[self._spy].Quantity)

        if self._held_symbol is not None:
            if self.Portfolio[self._held_symbol].Quantity == 0 and self._entry_order_id is None:
                self._clear_position_state()
            else:
                expiry = self._date_only(self._held_symbol.ID.Date)
                if self.Time.date() >= expiry:
                    self._no_entry_date = self.Time.date()
                    self._submit_exit("Expiration processing")
                else:
                    self._check_profit_target(slice)

        if self._entry_signal_time == self.Time:
            self._entry_signal_time = None
            self._try_enter(slice)

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        if self._entry_order_id is not None and order_event.OrderId == self._entry_order_id:
            if order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                ticket = self.Transactions.GetOrderTicket(order_event.OrderId)
                self._entry_price = ticket.AverageFillPrice if ticket is not None else order_event.FillPrice
                self._held_symbol = order_event.Symbol
                self._entry_order_id = None
                self.Debug(f"Entered 1 {self._held_symbol} call at {self._entry_price:.2f}.")
            elif order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.Debug(f"Entry order for {order_event.Symbol} was not filled: {order_event.Status}.")
                self._entry_order_id = None
                self._held_symbol = None
                self._entry_price = None

        if self._exit_order_id is not None and order_event.OrderId == self._exit_order_id:
            if order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.Debug(f"Exited {order_event.Symbol} at {order_event.FillPrice:.2f}.")
                self._clear_position_state()
            elif order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self._exit_order_id = None

    def _on_five_minute_bar(self, sender, bar):
        old_fast = self._previous_fast
        old_slow = self._previous_slow

        self._fast.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self._slow.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        current_fast = self._fast.Current.Value
        current_slow = self._slow.Current.Value

        if (
            self._fast.IsReady
            and self._slow.IsReady
            and old_fast is not None
            and old_slow is not None
            and old_fast <= old_slow
            and current_fast > current_slow
            and (bar.EndTime.hour > 9 or (bar.EndTime.hour == 9 and bar.EndTime.minute >= 45))
            and (bar.EndTime.hour < 14 or (bar.EndTime.hour == 14 and bar.EndTime.minute <= 30))
        ):
            self._entry_signal_time = bar.EndTime

        self._previous_fast = current_fast
        self._previous_slow = current_slow

        if (
            self._held_symbol is not None
            or self._entry_order_id is not None
            or self._exit_order_id is not None
            or self._no_entry_date == self.Time.date()
        ):
            return

        if underlying_price <= 0:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: SPY has no valid current price.")
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains.get(self._option_symbol, None)
        if chain is None:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: no SPY option chain in current Slice.")
            return

        minimum_expiry = self.Time.date() + timedelta(days=7)
        expiries = sorted({
            self._date_only(contract.Expiry)
            for contract in chain
            if self._date_only(contract.Expiry) >= minimum_expiry
        })

        if not expiries:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: no expiration at least 7 calendar days away.")
            return

        expiry = expiries[0]
        minimum_strike = underlying_price * 1.01
        candidates = [
            contract for contract in chain
            if contract.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and self._date_only(contract.Expiry) == expiry
            and contract.Strike >= minimum_strike
        ]

        if not candidates:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry: no qualifying call for {expiry}.")
            return

        selected = sorted(candidates, key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))[0]
        self._held_symbol = selected.Symbol
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected.Symbol, 1)
        self._entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId

    def _check_profit_target(self, slice):
        if (
            self._held_symbol is None
            or self._entry_price is None
            or self._exit_order_id is not None
            or self.Portfolio[self._held_symbol].Quantity <= 0
        ):
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains.get(self._option_symbol, None)
        if chain is None:
            return

        contract = next((c for c in chain if c.Symbol == self._held_symbol), None)
        if contract is None or contract.BidPrice <= 0 or contract.AskPrice <= 0:
            return

        midpoint = (contract.BidPrice + contract.AskPrice) / 2.0
        if midpoint >= self._entry_price * 1.50:
            self._submit_exit("50% profit target")

    def _time_stop(self):
        if (
            self._held_symbol is None
            or self._exit_order_id is not None
            or self.Portfolio[self._held_symbol].Quantity <= 0
        ):
            return

        expiry = self._date_only(self._held_symbol.ID.Date)
        next_open = self.Securities[self._spy].Exchange.Hours.GetNextMarketOpen(self.Time, False)

        if self._date_only(next_open) == expiry:
            self._submit_exit("Pre-expiration 15:45 time stop")

    def _submit_exit(self, reason):
        if (
            self._held_symbol is None
            or self._exit_order_id is not None
            or self.Portfolio[self._held_symbol].Quantity == 0
        ):
            return

        for order in self.Transactions.GetOpenOrders(self._held_symbol):
            self.Transactions.CancelOrder(order.Id)

        quantity = self.Portfolio[self._held_symbol].Quantity
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(self._held_symbol, -quantity)
        self._exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self.Debug(f"{reason}: submitted market exit for {self._held_symbol}.")

    def _clear_position_state(self):
        self._held_symbol = None
        self._entry_price = None
        self._entry_order_id = None
        self._exit_order_id = None

    def _date_only(self, value):
        return value.date() if hasattr(value, "date") else value

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time


class SpyFiveMinuteCallCrossover(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute).Symbol
        self.Securities[self.spy].SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)

        self.option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option.SetFilter(
            lambda universe: universe.IncludeWeeklys()
                                     .Strikes(-100, 100)
                                     .Expiration(0, 730)
        )
        self.option_symbol = self.option.Symbol

        self.fast = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow = SimpleMovingAverage(20)
        self.previous_fast = None
        self.previous_slow = None

        self.current_bucket_end = None
        self.current_bucket_bars = []

        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.entry_ticket = None
        self.exit_ticket = None
        self.expiration_block_date = None
        self.equity_cleanup_ticket = None

    def OnData(self, slice):
        self._handle_unexpected_spy_position()
        self._handle_expiration_processing()
        self._check_profit_target(slice)
        self._update_five_minute_bars(slice)

    def _update_five_minute_bars(self, slice):
        if self.spy not in slice.Bars:
            return

        bar = slice.Bars[self.spy]
        bar_end = bar.EndTime
        session_open = datetime.combine(bar_end.date(), time(9, 30))

        if bar_end <= session_open or bar_end.time() > time(16, 0):
            return

        minutes_from_open = int((bar_end - session_open).total_seconds() // 60)
        if minutes_from_open < 1 or minutes_from_open > 390:
            return

        bucket_minutes = ((minutes_from_open - 1) // 5 + 1) * 5
        bucket_end = session_open + timedelta(minutes=bucket_minutes)

        if self.current_bucket_end != bucket_end:
            self.current_bucket_end = bucket_end
            self.current_bucket_bars = []

        self.current_bucket_bars.append(bar)

        if bar_end != bucket_end:
            return

        expected_times = [
            bucket_end - timedelta(minutes=offset)
            for offset in range(4, -1, -1)
        ]
        actual_times = [x.EndTime for x in self.current_bucket_bars]

        if len(self.current_bucket_bars) != 5 or actual_times != expected_times:
            self.current_bucket_bars = []
            return

        close = self.current_bucket_bars[-1].Close
        prior_fast = self.fast.Current.Value if self.fast.IsReady else None
        prior_slow = self.slow.Current.Value if self.slow.IsReady else None

        self.fast.Update(bucket_end, close)
        self.slow.Update(bucket_end, close)

        bullish_cross = (
            prior_fast is not None
            and prior_slow is not None
            and self.fast.IsReady
            and self.slow.IsReady
            and prior_fast <= prior_slow
            and self.fast.Current.Value > self.slow.Current.Value
        )

        self.previous_fast = prior_fast
        self.previous_slow = prior_slow
        self.current_bucket_bars = []

        if bullish_cross and time(9, 45) <= bucket_end.time() <= time(14, 30):
            self._try_enter(slice)

    def _try_enter(self, slice):
        if self.expiration_block_date == self.Time.date():
            return

        if self.held_contract is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
            return

        if self.entry_ticket is not None and self._is_open(self.entry_ticket):
            return

        if self.exit_ticket is not None and self._is_open(self.exit_ticket):
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains.get(self.option_symbol)
        if chain is None:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: no SPY option chain in current Slice.")
            return

        current_spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy].Price
        if current_spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: SPY has no valid current price.")
            return

        minimum_expiry = self.Time.date() + timedelta(days=7)
        eligible_expiries = sorted({
            contract.Expiry.date()
            for contract in chain
            if contract.Expiry.date() >= minimum_expiry
        })

        if not eligible_expiries:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: no expiration at least 7 calendar days away.")
            return

        selected_expiry = eligible_expiries[0]
        minimum_strike = current_spy_price * 1.01

        candidates = [
            contract for contract in chain
            if contract.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and contract.Expiry.date() == selected_expiry
            and contract.Strike >= minimum_strike
        ]

        if not candidates:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: no qualifying call at selected expiration.")
            return

        selected = min(candidates, key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))
        self.entry_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected.Symbol, 1)
        self.Debug(
            f"Entry submitted: {selected.Symbol} expiry {selected_expiry} "
            f"strike {selected.Strike:.2f}"
        )

    def _check_profit_target(self, slice):
        if self.held_contract is None or not self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
            return

        if self.entry_price is None or self.exit_ticket is not None and self._is_open(self.exit_ticket):
            return

        quote_bar = slice.QuoteBars.get(self.held_contract)
        if quote_bar is None or quote_bar.Bid is None or quote_bar.Ask is None:
            return

        bid = quote_bar.Bid.Close
        ask = quote_bar.Ask.Close
        if bid <= 0 or ask <= 0:
            return

        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
        if midpoint >= self.entry_price * 1.50:
            self._cancel_open_exit()
            self.exit_ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                self.held_contract,
                -self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Quantity
            )
            self.Debug(
                f"Profit-target exit submitted: {self.held_contract}, "
                f"midpoint {midpoint:.2f}"
            )

    def _handle_expiration_processing(self):
        if self.held_contract is None or not self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
            return

        expiry = self.held_contract.ID.Date.date()
        today = self.Time.date()

        if today >= expiry:
            self.expiration_block_date = today
            if self.exit_ticket is None or not self._is_open(self.exit_ticket):
                self._cancel_open_exit()
                self.exit_ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                    self.held_contract,
                    -self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Quantity
                )
                self.Debug(f"Expiration-protection exit submitted: {self.held_contract}")
            return

        if self.Time.time() != time(15, 45):
            return

        if today == self._previous_trading_day(expiry):
            if self.exit_ticket is None or not self._is_open(self.exit_ticket):
                self._cancel_open_exit()
                self.exit_ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                    self.held_contract,
                    -self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Quantity
                )
                self.Debug(f"Pre-expiration exit submitted: {self.held_contract}")

    def _previous_trading_day(self, expiry):
        candidate = expiry - timedelta(days=1)
        hours = self.Securities[self.spy].Exchange.Hours

        while not hours.IsDateOpen(candidate, False):
            candidate -= timedelta(days=1)

        return candidate

    def _handle_unexpected_spy_position(self):
        if not self.Portfolio[self.spy].Invested:
            return

        if self.equity_cleanup_ticket is None or not self._is_open(self.equity_cleanup_ticket):
            quantity = self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity
            self.equity_cleanup_ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -quantity)
            self.Debug(
                f"Unexpected SPY exercise/assignment position detected; "
                f"liquidation submitted for {quantity} shares."
            )

    def _cancel_open_exit(self):
        if self.exit_ticket is not None and self._is_open(self.exit_ticket):
            self.exit_ticket.Cancel("Replacing open exit order.")

    def _is_open(self, ticket):
        return ticket.Status in [
            OrderStatus.New,
            OrderStatus.Submitted,
            OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled,
            OrderStatus.UpdateSubmitted,
            OrderStatus.CancelPending
        ]

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        if self.entry_ticket is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_ticket.OrderId:
            if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.held_contract = orderEvent.Symbol
                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.Debug(
                    f"Entry filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}"
                )
            elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.Debug(f"Entry order closed without fill: {orderEvent.Symbol}")
                self.entry_ticket = None

        if self.exit_ticket is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.exit_ticket.OrderId:
            if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.Debug(
                    f"Exit filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}"
                )
                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_price = None
                self.exit_ticket = None
            elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.exit_ticket = None
